spans.s:
हण्डा हण्डा, ind. a vocative particle used
in addressing a female of inferior rank; (in the
drama) a form of address used by equals to each other
among those of the lowest class.
हण्डे, ind. a vocative particle, = हण्डा above.

हण्डिका हण्डिका, f. an earthen pot or boiler.
—हण्डिका-सुत, अस्, m. a small earthen pot.
